reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves all eight allowed handoff needs and marks only exact need-to-capability matches as direct; unsupported records remain visible in the downstream coverage output.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: avoid generic or unrelated capability matches

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs ranks unsupported needs ahead of direct coverage, then orders within each group by upstream provenance rank, matching the stated downstream role and final priorities.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs ahead of directly covered needs
use upstream provenance rank as within-group ordering key

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation retains the full eight-row bounded priority window and constructs the deterministic recommendation from the already-ranked first record, producing decision prioritize and top_need isolate faulty execution branches before replay.

select_demand_records keeps all demanded records with demand_score >= 3 and explicit fallback records through the returned data path. In the supplied corpus all eight records qualify, so no downstream demand loss is visible here.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: retain explicit fallback records through returned data path

reviews.decision_reason: normalize_evidence preserves the allowed record identifiers n06-r01 through n06-r08, fills missing fields with neutral sentinels, and returns the bounded eight-record window used by the downstream handoff.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: use neutral JSON-safe sentinels for missing values

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance builds evidence_sources from normalized needs with record_id, source_id, source_weight, and rank, ordered by demand score descending with record_id tie break. The downstream consumed handoff hash matches the upstream producer hash for evidence_sources.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: assemble source provenance by demand-ranked ordering
